customers.evidence: We represent your voice, your needs and your investment goals in every decision we make.

employees.evidence: Culture inspires employees to go above and beyond their responsibilities every day

innovation.evidence: We are proud of our long history of innovation, driving continuous change to help investors achieve their goals.

result.analyst_notes: Declarative, aspirational headlines in first-person plural, with a CEO quote in first person. Client-first framing, with the fiduciary headline and 'every decision' language. Commitments are absolute ('never forget', 'every decision'). Innovation is a headline. Employees, DEI and integrity get brief mentions. Environment, community and safety are absent.
